assumptions: Checked on the ZERO-KNOWLEDGE CONFIGURATION of the fixture — the graph with every discharge stripped — because the fixture does hold three discharged narrowings and they are SUPPOSED to beat the baseline. That is the only thing a discharge is for.
Extensional equality on this fixture, by enumeration. Not a theorem about arbitrary graphs.
attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6’s ruling on R7.4 §8.1, made executable. R7.4 ASSERTED that with no discharged narrowing the typed closure equals the untyped closure and never computed the untyped closure to compare against. It does now, at every seed node. THIS IS THE ZERO-KNOWLEDGE THEOREM AND IT IS THE CORRECT RESULT RATHER THAN A SHORTFALL: sound abstract interpretation deliberately over-approximates, and with no trustworthy narrowing information the safe answer at every reached node is `I know this support edge may propagate impact, but I cannot prove how` — which is ⊤. Proven transfer semantics may then only IMPROVE precision and may never make the result less conservative. R7.4 asked whether typed = untyped means the typed machinery is premature; the ruling taken here is that it is the correct semantic result AND separately evidence that the machinery has no production precision benefit yet, and that those are not in tension.

coverage.domain: every node of impact_algebra.graph as a seed, in the zero-knowledge configuration — 10 seeds × 10 nodes compared against untyped reachability

attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, on ROUND7_4_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md §8.1, citing Cousot on abstract interpretation: sound analysis over-approximates; imprecision costs false alarms, omission costs soundness.

attrs.review_focus: This is the floor. IMPACT-PRECISION-REALIZED is the question of whether anything has ever risen above it, and IMPACT-PRECISION-FRONTIER is the discovery that under exact-match semantics most of the graph CANNOT.
attrs.statement: With no discharged narrowing on any edge, the typed impact closure is extensionally equal to untyped support reachability with every reachable node labelled ⊤.
